parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the topic to be created belongs.

parameters.name: topicName
parameters.description:
The name of the topic to be created. The name is used to identify the topic and must be globally unique.

Naming conventions:

- Character limit: letters a-z or A-Z, digits 0-9, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
- Length limit: 1 to 60 characters.

For reserved character restrictions, see [Parameter limits](~~440347~~).
